faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Sciorex, from pricing to privacy.

items.question: Is Sciorex really free?
items.answer: Yes, Sciorex is completely free for personal and professional use. There are no subscriptions, no premium tiers, and no hidden costs. We're a wrapper for existing AI CLIs, so you only pay for what you already use (your own API keys or local models).

items.question: Where is my data stored? Is Sciorex private?
items.answer: Sciorex never sends your data anywhere. All your conversations, code, and files stay 100% on your local machine. We don't collect analytics, telemetry, or usage data. The CLIs you use (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, etc.) are the only components that may communicate with external APIs, depending on their configuration.

items.question: What AI providers and CLIs does Sciorex support?
items.answer: Sciorex supports Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Codex CLI, and local models via LM Studio and Ollama. Since we wrap these existing tools, you get access to any AI provider they support, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models.

items.question: Do I need API keys to use Sciorex?
items.answer: Sciorex itself requires no API keys, no login, and no email. Just download and use it. The CLIs you connect are a different story: cloud-based CLIs like Claude Code or Gemini CLI need API keys from their providers, while local models via LM Studio or Ollama run entirely on your machine.

items.question: How is Sciorex different from Cursor or Windsurf?
items.answer: Unlike Cursor or Windsurf, Sciorex is a wrapper for existing AI CLIs rather than a standalone IDE. This means you bring your own AI provider, keep full control over your data, and can use any CLI you prefer. Sciorex adds visual workflows, ticket tracking, multi-agent orchestration, and a Kanban board on top of your existing tools.

items.question: Is Sciorex open source?
items.answer: Not yet. Some subcomponents are open source, but the main application is closed source for now. We plan to open source it once the project matures and the roadmap stabilizes. You can follow development, report issues, and request features on our GitLab repository.

items.question: What can I build with Sciorex?
items.answer: Sciorex excels at multi-step AI workflows: research pipelines that fetch and summarize papers, coding agents that implement features across multiple files, documentation generators, code review systems, and any task requiring multiple AI agents working together with human oversight.
